text: do  you know what bug this is where the prefab just doesnt show up here [Image #10]
resolution: Diagnosed the blank building stage for shitty_hotel. The prefab itself is healthy — pulled its latest prefabDefined def from the world stream sqlite and verified all 104 pieces have finite coords (0..15), valid yaws, and known catalog ids. What is unique about it: it is skinned with stored + painted materials (d-pdx-carpet, b-linoleum, custom:shitbrick0/1, b-rot-siding), so the stage mounts ~6 offscreen TextureCaptures where color-skinned buildings mount 0. That capture list was a BARE variable-length array directly before the fixed Pressable+Scene3D sibling — the documented reconciler array-sibling-shift trap: switching to a building with a different capture count shifts the Scene3D's host child index and the host DROPS the scene node permanently (React thinks it is still mounted, the engage-once native camera cannot recover it). Fix: each variable-length capture list now renders inside its own zero-size container Box so fixed siblings keep their indices — applied to BuildingStage and to GarmentStage which carried the same bare pattern. Bundle-checked hmsc-int with the real alias set (clean); dev host hot-reload should show shitty_hotel rendering on next look. Note: the custom:shitbrick0/1 painted materials may ALSO be missing from the store (the req_0695 8KB localstore bug ate painted material writes) — those faces will render bare until repainted after the host rebuild.
